setup.title: Set up {{name}}
setup.subtitle: Create the first admin account and workspace.
setup.tokenHint: The API prints it in its log on every start until setup is done.
setup.name: Your name
setup.workspaceHint: Your team's first workspace. You can add more later.
setup.done: You are the instance admin, and your workspace is ready.
setup.alreadySetUp: This instance is already set up.

testEmail.intro: Invites and password resets go out by email. Send yourself one to check that the SMTP settings work.
testEmail.sent: Sent to {{email}}. Check that inbox, and the spam folder.
testEmail.failed: Could not send the test email

emailCode.label: Sign in with an emailed code
emailCode.on: The sign-in page offers to email a six-digit code, so nobody needs a password to get in.
emailCode.off: Needs SMTP. Until this instance can send email, the sign-in page does not offer it.

creation.label: Who can create workspaces
creation.creatorsHint: Give the Workspace creator role to the people who start workspaces. Everyone else joins the ones they are invited to.
creation.everyoneHint: Anyone who can sign in can start a workspace.

workspaces.count: {{count}} workspaces on this instance. When nobody who owns a workspace can still sign in, make one of its members an owner.
workspaces.appointDescription: An owner runs data retention and exports, and can delete the workspace. The current owners stay owners.
workspaces.noCandidates: Nobody in this workspace has an active account who isn't already an owner.
workspaces.appointFailed: Could not make them an owner. Try again.
